title: Following a Claim Back to Its Source
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Open Educational Resources
description: A chain of four links that follows the claim "Wetlands filter pollutants" from a footnote to a textbook, a review article, and the study where the measurement was made.

educational.topic: Tracing a claim through a citation chain to the original source
learningObjectives: The learner will trace a claim through a chain of citations to its original source and explain why stopping at the first link is not enough.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Explore a reference picture, then quiz on the same picture
commonMisconceptions: A citation that exists proves the claim
A textbook agreeing with a resource is evidence
assessmentOpportunities: A reviewer stops at link 2. What has the reviewer found?
Which link is the original source?
The further back you trace a claim, what happens to the check?

controls.name: Explore and Quiz buttons
controls.description: switch between exploring the poster and answering quiz questions.

controls.name: Numbered markers
controls.description: hover or press to read about that part of the poster. In quiz mode a press is your answer.

controls.name: Try Again
controls.description: repeats the quiz after the last question.
